items.title: Home
items.text:
RoKitty is the Roblox website, redesigned.

Explore Roblox through a beautifully redesigned client, rewritten from the ground up. It's the same Roblox platform with a brand-new interface.

RoKitty is coming soon. For updates, please subscribe:

  • Right in your browser

    RoKitty is a web extension. Just install it in your browser and you're ready to go.

    Get started

  • Not a theme or patch

    Other extensions just modify Roblox.com. RoKitty is entirely separate, and you can swap back and forth anytime.

  • Completely local

    RoKitty is a custom client that lives on your computer. Your Roblox credentials never get sent away.

  • Roblox, better than ever

    RoKitty doesn't just reimplement Roblox.com, it adds tons of features that make Roblox just plain better to use.

    Explore features

items.title: Questions and answers
items.text:
If your question isn't answered here, please get in touch!

Is RoKitty compatible with other Roblox extensions?

You can keep using your other Roblox extensions while RoKitty is installed, but they only apply on Roblox.com and won't affect the RoKitty site. RoKitty tries its very best not to interfere with other extensions, and because RoKitty is a separate site, incompatibilities between it and other extensions are not expected. If you spot a major incompatibility, please get in touch.

What web browsers does RoKitty support?

RoKitty supports Google Chrome and Chromium derivatives, including Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, and Vivaldi. Support for Firefox and Safari is planned.

Is RoKitty made with AI?

No, so-called artificial intelligence tools (including LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and others) were not used in the development process of RoKitty. (Note that RoKitty as a project began before use of these tools was as widespread.) However, RoKitty uses and benefits immensely from many open-source dependencies, some of which may include AI generated code. For this reason, RoKitty is not free of indirectly included AI generated code. If you'd like to audit this, a list of dependencies is available in the About page of your RoKitty installation.

items.title: Features
items.text: This list isn't exhaustive, but it provides a good overview of what RoKitty offers.

items.title: Redesigned Roblox interface
items.text: Unlike popular Roblox extensions, RoKitty isn't a theme or modification. When you use RoKitty, you're using a totally new client, written from the ground up.

items.title: Back and forth
items.text: You can switch between RoKitty and Roblox.com at any time, using it as much or as little as you want. And because RoKitty stays separate from Roblox.com, all of your existing Roblox extensions still work.

items.title: Peek-a-boo!
items.text: No need to click, just hover over links to users for a little preview. And links to users, groups, and games go from long URLs to buttons, so you always know where you're going before you even click.

items.title: Super search
items.text: It's Cmd+K from anywhere for a smarter search across all of Roblox. Jump right into a game, directly from the search menu. Or paste in a Roblox.com link to jump to its equivalent page in RoKitty.

items.title: Groups
items.text: RoKitty's group page puts everything in the same place. All the information you're used to, plus the ability to easily see your friends' roles.

items.title: Unsupported features
items.text:
RoKitty aims to implement all the core features of Roblox, allowing you to use the RoKitty interface for as many actions on the Roblox platform as possible. However, you can't use RoKitty to do everything you can do on Roblox.com. Most features are planned and just aren't done yet, but some just aren't feasible for RoKitty to implement for security, privacy, or other technical reasons.

RoKitty never locks you in, so whenever a feature is missing you can always use Roblox.com or the Roblox app to fill the gap.

As RoKitty is under development and Roblox is always changing, a complete list of missing features is not available. If you need information about a specific feature, please get in touch.
